deployments_detail.use: "Decision Intelligence Pro" GenAI fraud detection (125B transactions/yr, 50ms) + "Agent Pay" agentic payments (Microsoft)

Internal rollout of Microsoft 365 Copilot to ~16,000 employees for productivity, plus AI coding assistants for developers; company reports millions of AI-driven actions and hundreds of thousands of hours saved. [Microsoft 365 Copilot]
deployments_detail.value: 16,000 employees enabled; 8M+ AI-driven actions and 800K+ hours saved (per Mastercard CDAO Greg Ulrich)

deployments_detail.use: Unlocked: AI-powered internal talent marketplace that matches employees to internal jobs, short-term projects, mentoring, learning and volunteering opportunities based on skills. [Gloat (talent marketplace AI)]

Shopping Muse: generative-AI conversational retail assistant from Dynamic Yield by Mastercard that translates shoppers' colloquial language into personalized product recommendations; first deployed by Michael Kors. [Dynamic Yield by Mastercard (generative AI)]

Mastercard Agent Pay: agentic-AI payments program enabling AI agents to discover, plan and execute secure autonomous transactions, using Agentic Tokens; partners include OpenAI, Microsoft, Stripe, Google. [Mastercard (Agentic Tokens); Microsoft, OpenAI, Stripe, Google]

Mastercard Small Business AI / Virtual C-Suite: generative-AI virtual assistant (Small Business AI, piloted 2024) evolved into Virtual C-Suite (2026), a set of AI agents giving SMEs executive-level insight and decision support. [Mastercard (generative AI)]

Open Banking / Open Finance analytics (Finicity, a Mastercard company): AI-driven cash-flow and income insights and credit-scoring models used by lenders for inclusive lending decisions. [Mastercard Finicity (AI analytics)]

Generative-AI digital assistant built on Mastercard's in-house gen-AI capability that simplifies customer/product onboarding so bank customers can extend new ways to pay faster. [Mastercard (in-house generative AI)]

Decision Intelligence: real-time AI transaction risk-scoring platform that analyzes each transaction against ~160 billion transactions/year to score fraud risk and reduce false declines. Built on Brighterion ML technology (acquired 2017). [Mastercard Brighterion (in-house ML)]

Decision Intelligence Pro: proprietary generative-AI/recurrent-neural-network model that scans up to 1 trillion data points to assess whether a transaction is genuine, improving issuer fraud detection. [Mastercard (proprietary generative AI / RNN)]
deployments_detail.value: up to 300% improvement in fraud detection rates in some cases; scans 1 trillion data points

deployments_detail.use: Generative-AI predictive technology that identifies compromised payment cards faster by predicting full card details of cards likely exposed in breaches, alerting banks to block/reissue. [Mastercard (generative AI)]
deployments_detail.value: doubled speed of detecting compromised cards; up to 300% faster identification of at-risk merchants

deployments_detail.use: Consumer Fraud Risk (CFR): AI that scores real-time account-to-account payments to predict Authorised Push Payment (APP) scams before money leaves the victim's account; deployed with UK banks (Lloyds, NatWest, Monzo, TSB, etc.). [Mastercard (AI, built on Brighterion / network intelligence)]

Fraud detection and prevention running on AWS AI/ML services (Brighterion applications), delivering higher fraud catch rates and fewer false positives for merchants and acquirers. [AWS (AI/ML services); Mastercard Brighterion]
deployments_detail.value: 3x more fraudulent transactions detected; false positives reduced tenfold; billions in merchant savings
